Where do you land the items? Which room do you start in? Shalon keeps a clear corridor for everyday use? Questions are worth settling before the arrival of the paint, so that what you spend the entire working day definitely moves from corner to second.

Then discuss the division of labor with the contractor according to the condition of the walls and the required materials.
strings.اختَر ترتيبًا يناسب يومكم: Choose an arrangement that suits your day.
strings.ممكن تبدأ بغرفة قليلة الاستخدام، مع إبقا: You can start with a minimally used room, keeping space separate for everyday purposes. If you have a home office or shift time, explain when you need quietness or privacy. Don’t assume that painting an entire room and delivering it the same day fits every project; processing and drying determine the order of steps.
strings.حدّد من البداية مكان تجميع المواد والأدو: Determine from the beginning where the materials and tools are collected, the route of entry of workers and the transfer of equipment. If the house is inside a building, make sure the elevator arrangements and working hours agreed with the management, instead of detecting restrictions after the start of work.

Collect nails, cut curtains and small accessories with separate bags, and picture their arrangement if you need a reference at the time of installation. Move important papers, small appliances and breakable objects yourself or clearly define the responsibility of moving them.
strings.لا تكدّس القطع بطريقة تمنع الوصول للجدار: Do not stack the pieces in a way that prevents access to the wall. Any work in electrical connections is left to the eligible person.
strings.خلّ ممرات الدخول والخروج خالية من العلب: Vinegar entry and exit lanes are free of cans and wires, and select a work space separate from everyday use as much as possible. Keep children and pets away from tools, materials and the execution area, and store your daily needs outside them before you start.
